mechanics.claim: Rocket Grab stuns the first enemy hit and pulls them toward Blitzcrank, revealing them during the pull.
mechanics.quote: stunning them for {{fd|0.65 seconds}}, and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them towards '''Blitzcrank''', during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}

mechanics.claim: Blitzcrank automatically basic attacks the target once it arrives, providing a free attack (and on-hit effects) after the grab lands.
mechanics.quote: '''Blitzcrank''' will be ordered to {{tip|basic attack}} the target once the target arrives.

mechanics.claim: If the target dies to Rocket Grab's damage, they are not pulled, meaning the follow-up auto-attack would not occur.
mechanics.quote: If the target dies to ''Rocket Grab's'' damage, they will not be pulled.

mechanics.claim: Can be blocked by spell shields.
